job_description:
We are looking for a Backend Developer/Backend Engineer to join our team at at Crystal Group, contributing to software, data, or IT system development and support. This role offers an in-hand salary of ₹15,000 -25,000 and a chance to work in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop, test, or maintain software applications, databases, or analytical tools

Analyze data, generate insights, and ensure system accuracy

Troubleshoot issues and support daily IT operations

Collaborate with teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions

Follow documentation, security, and testing standards

Job Requirements:

The minimum qualification for this role is 12th Pass and 1 - 3 years of experience. Hands-on knowledge of Python, PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, Problem Solving, Testing/ QA (Manual/Automation), SEO, Communication and modern tools is essential. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills required.

Interview timing 10am to 5pm (Riyal residency, nr primary school, New maninagar, Ramol)
